fullDescription: A high-octane, 'Cosmic Revenge' aesthetic designed for gaming character profiles, cinematic landing pages, and dark-themed entertainment sites. The style features a deep space palette (#020005) punctuated by aggressive blood-red (#ef4444) and electric purple (#7e22ce) accents. Key elements include glitch typography, animated star fields, aura-pulse shadows, and a grainy noise overlay that provides a gritty, supernatural feel. This layout is optimized for high-impact visual storytelling with a focus on powerful character imagery and bold, editorial-style typography using Cabinet Grotesk and Tanker.
prompt:
## Resumo
An epic cosmic dark character profile page with a 2-column grid, featuring animated space backgrounds, glowing red text, glitch effects, and aura-pulsing containers. The design leverages a dark-mode-only approach with neon accents and high-contrast visuals.

## Estilo Visual
Set the base background to #020005 with a grain overlay (mix-blend-overlay at 40% opacity). Implement a star field using repeating radial gradients (2px stars) that animate linearly: transform: translate(1000px, 1000px) over 100s. Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' (900 weight) for main headings with text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,0,0,0.8). Primary accent color is Red-600 (#dc2626) and Purple-700 (#7e22ce). Apply a glitch animation to specific keywords that shifts X and Y coordinates by 2px randomly every 0.4s. All primary containers should have a border-radius of 24px-40px. Use blur(120px) for background decorative light blobs in red and purple.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation/Badge
A small, pill-shaped badge with 40% opacity dark red background (#450a0a/40) and 30% red border. Content includes a 'flame' icon and uppercase tracking-widest text (font-size: 0.875rem).

### Hero Section
A two-column grid. Left side: A massive heading in Cabinet Grotesk (text-9xl) with a line-height of 'none' and tracking-tighter. Below this, a paragraph in Gray-400 (Archivo, text-xl) limited to max-width: 512px. Right side: A large 4:5 aspect ratio image card with 40px rounded corners and a border-red-500/20. Apply an 'aura-pulse' animation that oscillates box-shadow from 20px to 100px using red and purple hues.

### Ability Cards
Bento-style skill indicators below the text. Each card features 5% white background, a 12x12 (w/h) color-filled icon box (red or purple), and two-tier text (uppercase gray label over bold white value). On hover, the icon box scales 110% and the card background shifts to 30% accent color.

### Status Overlay
Inside the character image, place a bottom-anchored panel with backdrop-blur-md and 60% black background. Include a status bar using a 4px tall container with a 92% red-600 fill that has a red outer glow shadow.

### Footer
A full-width section with a thin 5% white top border. Left side features 'ULTRA KOZMİK' branding in 'Tanker' font with red-600 coloring and 0.25em tracking. Right side displays social icons (size 24px) that transition to red-500 on hover.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Glitch Heading — A word within a heading that appears to 'shake' and flicker independently.
Target a specific span within the H1. Apply 'glitch-effect' animation: keyframes shifting translate(-2px, 2px) to (2px, -2px) through 5 steps over 2s. Color must be #dc2626 with bright red glow.

### Aura Pulse Image Container — The main visual container that emits a magical/cosmic energy pulse.
Container with border-radius: 40px and overflow: hidden. Animation: 'aura-pulse' 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate. Keyframes: 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,0,0,0.2) } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(255,0,0,0.5), 0 0 100px rgba(138,43,226,0.5) }.

## Notas Especiais
MUST use a grain texture overlay to achieve the cinematic look. MUST NOT use standard blue-light modes; keep all glows in the red/purple spectrum. Headings MUST be uppercase to maintain the aggressive aesthetic. Animation on stars MUST be infinite and linear.
